links.outcome: Hallucinations and appropriateness of LLM health suggestions for patients with clinical constraints
links.effect: No factual hallucinations were generated, but some accurate general health suggestions could be inappropriate for users with specific clinical constraints.
links.quote: While MarIA did not generate factual hallucinations, some general health suggestions-though accurate in isolation-could be inappropriate for users with specific clinical constraints.

unlisted_practices: Personalized multi-agent dialogue styles to increase patient engagement with a chatbot
Embedded safety layer to detect unsuitable recommendations given patient profile

screen.reason: Evaluates a multi-agent LLM chatbot deployed to 35 patients with diabetes over 3 months, assessing user experience, engagement, and safety risks.
